note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-26 (Tier 2). Flora (`flora`, MG / Supporter / Electric / Burst II, cd 40s, ammo 300): a healer-buffer whose OWN MG damage is minor and whose value is TEAM-WIDE through her BURST (a big team ATK nuke + True Damage + a recovery heal) and her S1 HoT (which keeps recovery-consumer teammates refreshed). The load-bearing, faithfully-modelable lines are her BURST buffs; her S2 is entirely gated on HP dynamics the v1 sim does not model and is dropped to unmodeled with an engine-core flag (below). MODELED: (burst) 'Restores HP = 10.45% of caster final Max HP' -> a `heal` to all allies on burstCast (no HP amount modeled — v1 has no HP pool — but it emits the recovery event that fires recovery-consumer teammates, e.g. crown's +20.99% Attack Damage); (burst) 'True Damage ▲ 42.39% for 10 sec' -> trueDamagePct 42.39 / 10s on burstCast to all allies — the engine gates trueDamagePct by damage FLAVOR (sim.ts:1430), so it benefits ONLY true-flavored damage (e.g. ada's Flash Grenade dot) and is exactly inert on allies dealing no true damage; (burst) 'ATK ▲ 85.86% of the skill user's ATK for 10 sec' -> casterAtkPct 85.86 / 10s on burstCast to all allies — '% of the skill user's ATK' is the caster-scaled flat-ATK path (crown S1 precedent), NOT a plain atkPct (% of each target's OWN ATK), which would over-buff high-ATK carries and under-buff low-ATK ones; (skill1) 'Peace of Mind: Restores HP = 1% of caster final Max HP every 1 sec continuously' (self + both adjacent allies) -> an interval:1 `heal` to selfAndAdjacent(sides:2), modeling the kit's 1s recovery cadence (the per-tick HP magnitude is not modeled — no HP pool — but the recovery EVENT cadence is, which is what recovery consumers key off). The 'activates at the start of battle as long as this unit is alive' clause is satisfied by the interval trigger running from battle start (units are immortal in v1). UNMODELED (verbatim lines in `unmodeled`, each with a structured caveat below): skill1 'Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks 5x' (no incomingHealingPct stat + no HP pool to scale -> doubly inert); skill1 'after 100 normal attacks, all Electric Code allies: +1 stack to stackable buffs' (trigger hitCount:100 + target alliesOfElement Electric are expressible but the stack-increment EFFECT has no engine primitive -> engine-core flag); skill1 'entering Burst Stage 2, Peace-of-Mind allies: Max HP ▲ 15.01% of caster Max HP for 2 sec (without restoring HP)' (offensively inert per the e3 ally-granted-MaxHP rule + the 'Peace of Mind state' target gate is unexpressible); ALL of skill2 (shield 10.22% / True Damage 30.97% / ATK 45.12%) — every S2 line is gated on an HP threshold the sim cannot represent (no HP pool; the boss deals no damage, so no ally ever drops below 100% HP and the 'HP <= 90%' shield trigger, the 'reaches max HP' True Damage trigger, and the 'shield placed in front of this unit' ATK trigger never fire). This is the SAME out-of-domain treatment as liter's cover-HP NO-OP (owner ruling 2026-07-21) and the alliesLowestHp 'v1 has no HP pool' stand-in: it is a structural v1 limitation, NOT an encoding choice, so it is flagged engine-core rather than NO-GO. CONSEQUENCE: the sim under-represents Flora's real team contribution (her high-uptime S2 ATK/True-Damage buffs are absent) until an HP pool exists; her fully-modeled burst is her defining meta contribution. PINNED end-to-end by scripts/tests/units/flora.test.ts (F1 burst casterAtkPct 85.86 moves the carry + is caster-scaled not target-scaled; F2 burst trueDamagePct 42.39 is flavor-gated — moves ada's true grenades, byte-identical on non-true damage; F3/F4 burst heal + S1 HoT emit recovery events that drive crown's recovery consumer). Cross-family: routing deviation this run — S2b/S7 kimi-k3, S5/S6 kimi-k2.7 (owner override; Claude quota exhausted).

skill1: Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously. Stacks up to 5 times. — no incomingHealingPct stat exists and v1 models no HP pool, so healing-received scaling is doubly inert (damage-neutral).

■ Activates after landing 100 normal attacks. Affects all Electric Code allies. Increases the stack count of stackable buffs by 1. — trigger (hitCount:100) + target (alliesOfElement Electric) expressible, but the EFFECT (increment every active stackable buff's stack count by 1) has no engine primitive. ⚑ engine-core (see caveats).

■ Activates when entering Burst Stage 2. Affects all allies in the Peace of Mind state. Max HP ▲ 15.01% of the skill user's max HP (without restoring HP) for 2 sec. — offensively inert (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, e3 video rule; 'without restoring HP' so no recovery event) and the 'Peace of Mind state' target gate has no expression.
skill2: ■ Activates when the HP of an adjacent ally drops to 90% or below while the ally is still alive. Affects all allies. Creates a shield with 10.22% of the skill user's final max HP that lasts for 10 sec. — HP-threshold trigger; v1 has no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so no ally ever drops below 100% HP and this never fires. ⚑ engine-core (see caveats).

■ Activates when either adjacent ally reaches max HP. Affects all allies. True Damage ▲ 30.97% for 10 sec. — 'reaches max HP' is an HP-transition trigger that needs an HP pool the sim does not model. ⚑ engine-core.

■ Activates when a shield is placed in front of this unit. Affects all allies in the Peace of Mind state. ATK ▲ 45.12% of the skill user's ATK for 10 sec. — the `shielded` trigger EXISTS, but its only shield source is the S2 line above (HP-gated), so the chain is dead in the no-damage sim; the 'Peace of Mind state' target gate is also unexpressible. ⚑ engine-core.

caveats: skill2 (WHOLE SLOT) ⚑ engine-core: all three S2 lines (shield 10.22% / True Damage ▲ 30.97% / ATK ▲ 45.12% of caster ATK) are gated on HP dynamics v1 does not model. ESTIMATE: in a real fight Flora's S1 HoT (1%/s) + burst heal (10.45%) keep adjacent allies near max HP, so the 'HP <= 90%' shield and 'reaches max HP' True Damage triggers fire on boss-damage cadence -> high uptime on the 45.12% caster-ATK + 30.97% True Damage team buffs; this is a meaningful, unmodeled fraction of her real team contribution (the sim under-represents Flora until an HP pool exists). RECIPE: add an engine HP-pool + HP-threshold-trigger primitive (model ally HP, boss damage taken, and 'HP <= X%' / 'reaches max HP' triggers), then encode S2-1 `shield` maxHpPct:10.22 on the HP-threshold trigger, S2-3 casterAtkPct:45.12 on `shielded`, S2-2 trueDamagePct:30.97 on a max-HP-reached trigger. TIER: engine-core (new primitive), out-of-domain for the no-damage v1 sim — same precedent as liter's cover-HP NO-OP (owner 2026-07-21) and the alliesLowestHp 'no HP pool' stand-in.

skill1 (stack bump) ⚑ engine-core: 'after 100 normal attacks, all Electric Code allies: Increases the stack count of stackable buffs by 1'. ESTIMATE: adds 1 stack to each Electric ally's active stackable buffs once per 100 Flora normal hits; magnitude depends entirely on which stack-ramp buffs are active on those allies (could be large if a stack-ramp buff is present, zero otherwise). RECIPE: an engine 'addStack' effect that increments existing buff stacks by N on a trigger (none exists). TIER: engine-core (new primitive).

skill1 (Incoming Healing) ⚑ inert: 'Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks 5x' — no incomingHealingPct stat and no HP pool, so it scales only heals received (unmodeled). ESTIMATE: damage-neutral. RECIPE: none for DPS (would need an HP pool + incomingHealingPct stat). TIER: inert/out-of-domain.

skill1 (Max HP grant) ⚑ inert: 'entering Burst Stage 2 -> Peace-of-Mind allies Max HP ▲ 15.01% of caster Max HP for 2 sec (without restoring HP)' — ally-granted Max HP is offensively inert (e3 video rule: does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct) and emits no recovery ('without restoring HP'); the 'Peace of Mind state' target gate is also unexpressible. ESTIMATE: damage-neutral. RECIPE: none for DPS. TIER: inert.

burst/skill1 heals: the HP MAGNITUDES (burst 10.45%, HoT 1%/s) are not modeled (no HP pool) — only the recovery EVENT cadence is, which is what recovery-consumer teammates key off. The interval:1 HoT phase starts at t=1s (engine interval convention 'first at t=sec'); a t=0 first tick would add one extra early recovery event, immaterial to steady-state consumer uptime.
